rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the core mechanism: λ=0 degeneracy between CBO⁻ and LCBO, finite-λ selection of LCBO as the lower-energy state, λ² scaling (fit exponent 1.98), and the instability condition sign matching in 7/7 tested points. However, the absolute magnitude of the closed-form Eq.(4) prefactor does not match the numerical results due to unspecified SM normalization details. The 9-band DFT model (Figs.3,5) was not built as external parameters were unavailable. Self-consistency was approximated rather than solved. The mechanism is robustly confirmed but quantitative prefactor agreement is missing.
